chunks: From the servant of Allah, 'Ali, Commander of the Faithful, to Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan
ai.seo_question: Who is the sender and recipient of the second letter in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This salutation appears in the famous letter to Mu'awiya (Letter 56), where Imam Ali asserts his legitimacy as the rightful successor and commander of the faithful, contrasting his divine appointment with Mu'awiya's hereditary ambition. It sets the stage for the theological and political arguments regarding justice and authority that define the early Shia narrative of the Caliphate.
